claims: Planeta Alofoke is a 24/7 reality show produced by Alofoke Media Group.
Planeta Alofoke is a 24/7 reality competition often referred to as "La Casa de Alofoke".
La Casa de Alofoke involves influencers and media personalities.
Planeta Alofoke is set in a spaceship (nave espacial).
The spaceship is produced by Santiago Matías's team.
Planeta Alofoke combines games, missions, and drama.
Planeta Alofoke's content is streamed on YouTube and other platforms.
Alofoke Media Group is led by Santiago Matías (Alofoke).
Planeta Alofoke partners with TelevisaUnivision for broader distribution.
Planeta Alofoke has official Instagram pages such as @planetaalofoke and @planetalofokeoficial.
